name: GetSites
description: Retrieves a list of SharePoint sites accessible by the authenticated Microsoft 365 user.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Outlook Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and access SharePoint sites through Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns a list of sites including their ID, display name, web URL, and other metadata.
